name: Advanced Image Grabber
author: mansurahamed

sections.description:
Import free web images instantly for your WordPress media to use in your website– no costs, full free!

Official Developer: Mansur Ahamed

Features

Advanced Image Grabber can import all images into your media library from external webpage urls.
You can click and select the images to upload and import just by one click.
This plugin is extremely useful for the people who doesn’t want to spend hours to search image in web and manually upload to wordpress media library.
No need costly AI fee. You can now get full free images within your dashboard to use in your website.

  • Easy to use
  • See live import status , success and failure
  • Browse all imported image on click from same page
  • Keeps orignal image name when importing
  • Fully responsive and one click image selection
  • Easy to use
  • Simple admin page
sections.installation:
First download the ZIP file ,

You can either install it automatically from the WordPress admin, or do it manually.

  1. Unzip the archive and put the ‘advanced-image-grabber’ folder into your plugins folder (/wp-content/plugins/)
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. You should now see Image Grabber menu at your dashboard
  4. Click on any any tags there or use your custom URL to fetch images there
  5. Once images are shown, click on any image to select it, you can select multiple.
  6. Then go to bottom of page and click import images button
  7. Done! image will be downloaded to your media library.
